entry.name: /cad-plan --gaps writes the next free plan number
entry.expected: On a phase directory already holding PLAN.md and reports/plan-1.md, /cad-plan --gaps creates PLAN-2.md and leaves PLAN.md and reports/plan-1.md byte-identical (sha256 before and after).
entry.why_human: No probe exercised it and none can without mutating the repo: the plan file is written by a spawned planner agent following workflow prose, so settling it needs a real /cad-plan --gaps run that dispatches a planner and writes into .planning/phases/<N>/. Nothing in the tree pins the rule either - grep for 'plan-gaps' and 'next free plan' across cadence-core/bin/*.test.mjs and self-verify.mjs returns nothing - so code inspection can confirm only that the instruction exists at plan-gaps.md:17-40, plan.md:185 and cad-planner-contract/SKILL.md:192 and is carried to the planner, not that the write lands where it says.
